newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Defiance Foods disappointed at NZCC ruling.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Defiance Foods disappointed at NZCC ruling.

text.p: Defiance Foods Chairman Tom O'Brien on Monday expressed "considerable disappointment" that the New Zealand Commerce Commission had decided to not clear the sale of the company's New Zealand milling and baking assets to Goodman Fielder, but said the conditional agreement remained current.

"This gives both vendors and purchases the time to consider fully the findings of the Commerce Commission and their respective positions to best determine whether and how they might meet the concerns expressed by the commission," O'Brien said in a statement.
He said the offer of NZ$48 million for the assets was fair.
